label: Utilization from cell area
subgoals: Define core utilization as cell area over core area
Divide total cell area by the target utilization

label: Aspect ratio and core dimensions
subgoals: Compute the core width as the square root of area over aspect ratio
Multiply the width by the aspect ratio for the height
Round the height to whole rows and the width to whole sites

label: From core to die
subgoals: Add twice the margin to each core dimension
Multiply the padded dimensions for the die area
Compare the margin overhead of small and large blocks
